question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Sufficient
solution:
The correct answer is **Enough**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sufficient: **as much as is necessary; enough.
 
• **Enough: **as much or as many of something as necessary.
 
• **​**Thus, the most appropriate synonym for **'****Sufficient' **is **'****Enough'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Lacking: **not having enough of something.
 
• **Large: **big.
 
• **Deficient: **not having enough of something.
